subject: POC trial planning - Acme Corp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@acme.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-25T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: POC trial planning - Acme Corp

Thanks for the call this morning — great to meet the Acme team. Quick recap and proposed plan:

Summary of needs:
- Evaluate latency and cost for customer-facing chat flows (avg session ~250 tokens)
- Validate prefix/KV caching improves p99 latency under concurrent sessions
- Confirm integration with Acme's VPC for Private deployment

Proposed success criteria:
1) End-to-end median latency < 300ms and p95 < 600ms
2) 30% reduction in per-request token cost vs current baseline (open model + caching)
3) Integration test: inference traffic routed via Acme VPC with no auth errors

Evaluation plan & timeline:
- Kickoff: 2026-07-08 (proposed) - project alignment + network checks
- Week 1 (07/08 - 07/14): setup environment, install agent, network smoke tests
- Week 2 (07/15 - 07/21): baseline runs, apply caching/batching config
- Week 3 (07/22 - 07/28): scale tests, regression checks
- Final readout: 2026-07-29 - share results and recommendation

Owners:
- Marissa Cole (AM) - overall POC owner, business goals
- Monica Patel (CS) - onboarding, metrics, final readout
- Dev Patel (Solutions Eng) - infra/network setup, performance tuning

Immediate next steps:
- Confirm kickoff date (proposed 07/08 or alternative)
- I'll share SOW and network checklist (attached) and a DocuSign link for signatures
- Please share a technical contact and test VM access (if available)

Attachments: POC_SOW_Acme_v1.pdf, network_access_checklist.xlsx
Related links: https://redwood.hubspot.com/deal/ACME-2026-001, https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/pocec

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Thanks all — quick tech note from our side prior to kickoff: 

Network/infra checklist highlights (summary):
- Allow outbound ports 443 and 8443 to redwood-inference endpoints (list in attached checklist)
- If you're using a proxy, ensure CONNECT is allowed for the agent host
- Test VM: a small Ubuntu 22.04 instance with 2 vCPU / 4GB RAM is sufficient for smoke tests
- Please provide a test account (username + ssh key or temporary password) and the IP we should expect traffic from so we can add it to the allowlist
- If traffic will route through a NAT/gateway, confirm translation mapping so we can validate CIDR ranges

I'll follow up in a separate invite for a 30-minute tech alignment call the week of the kickoff. If Sam can share the VM details beforehand, we can pre-provision and avoid delays.
